row.evidence: Fleet's pricing page lists 'Automatic user creation (JIT, SCIM)' under Premium ($7.00/host/month, the only paid self-serve tier), and the REST API docs say Fleet's SCIM endpoints map IdP users to hosts and 'automatically delete a user's Fleet account when the user is deleted or deactivated in the IdP.'
row.notes: New row; Fleet = fleetdm.com device management. SCIM 2.0 (Users, Groups, Schemas, ServiceProviderConfig, ResourceTypes; PUT and PATCH; no Bulk) is Premium, which is also the team plan, so no tax. Edge case for merge review: Fleet's SCIM users are 'end users' attached to hosts, not Fleet console accounts. Console accounts are created by SAML JIT (Premium) or invite/API, and SCIM deactivate/delete removes the matching Fleet account. Pricing is per host, not per user, so per-user fields are null. SAML SSO is on Free. Okta has an Okta-built 'FleetDM' OIN app with SCIM; Entra uses a non-gallery app with the generic URL; Google Workspace is a Fleet-run directory pull.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Priced per host (device), not per user.

scim.notes: Fleet's SCIM endpoint stores IdP 'end users' (people assigned to hosts) and their groups/department as host vitals; it does not create Fleet console accounts (those come from JIT on SSO login or invites). Deleting or deactivating a user over SCIM deletes the matching Fleet account. The Okta setup in Fleet's guide uses a SAML app only as a container for SCIM, so SSO into Fleet is not a prerequisite.

auth.token_source: API token of a Fleet API-only user with admin permissions and access to /scim/* endpoints

deprovision.notes: Deactivating or deleting the SCIM user deletes the corresponding Fleet account.

custom.how: Guide says payloads with attributes other than the supported ones are rejected

roles.how: SCIM groups map to IdP host vitals, not Fleet roles; Fleet roles are assigned through JIT SAML attributes (FLEET_JIT_USER_ROLE_*)

limitations.text: SCIM users are end-user records mapped to hosts, not Fleet console accounts; Fleet accounts are created by JIT on SSO login, by invite or through the users API.
Google Workspace is not SCIM: Fleet pulls users and groups from the Admin SDK Directory API instead, and SCIM is ignored while that is configured.

auth.notes: Bearer API token tied to a Fleet user or API-only user; permissions follow that user's role.

endpoints.purpose: Force password reset, log out and revoke API tokens
Delete a user's sessions and API token

webhooks_user_events.notes: Pricing page describes webhooks for host, policy and CVE status changes; user-event webhooks not checked.

okta.notes: OIN 'FleetDM' app marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Sync Password and Group Push (read from page markup). Fleet's docs say Okta built it and Fleet still recommends a custom SAML app; Fleet's SCIM guide uses a custom app with the generic SCIM base URL.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (fleet-tutorial / fleetdm-tutorial 404). Fleet's guide provisions via a non-gallery Entra app pointed at the generic SCIM URL.

google.notes: Custom SAML app for SSO; Fleet-run Admin SDK directory pull for IdP host vitals, not Fleet accounts.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace Admin SDK directory sync for IdP host vitals (end users), Premium

conflicts.text: The pricing row 'Automatic user creation (JIT, SCIM)' implies SCIM creates Fleet users, but its tooltip mentions only JIT and the SCIM docs say SCIM maps end users to hosts and deletes (rather than creates) Fleet accounts.
Okta lists an Okta-built FleetDM app with SCIM provisioning, while Fleet's SSO docs say it is still being tested and recommend a custom SAML app.
